audit_question: Does an LLM response attach the target's raw physical unit to a numeric transformed replay score?
scope: Parsed proposal and critic responses only; prompts and hidden target values are excluded.

violations.text: Binary lanthanide oxides (e.g., YbO) yield high bulk modulus (~70 GPa). Binary/ternary lanthanide-chalcogen oxides with mean_z_mid and no transition metals are the best-supported next region to exploit.
Observed YbO at 70.24 GPa confirms oxide + lanthanide + binary + mean_z_mid as the highest-performing schema cell.

Binary lanthanide oxides with mean_z_mid and no transition metals yield the highest bulk modulus in this dataset. The single observed YbO at 70.24 GPa strongly supports this cell; Ce1O1 replicates it exactly and is the best next probe to confirm whether the pattern generalizes across lanthanides or is Yb-specific.
YbO (oxide, binary, lanthanide, mean_z_mid, no_TM, moderately_concentrated) scored 70.24 GPa — the highest observed outcome and the only entry in this schema cell.

The observed target evidence unambiguously identifies oxide + binary + lanthanide + mean_z_mid + no_TM + moderately_concentrated as the highest-performing schema cell. Ce1O1 is the only eligible candidate that occupies that cell, carries the highest GP EI on the menu, and is the GP rank-1 default. There is no competing eligible candidate with a credible mechanism to beat 70.24 GPa — the ternary lanthanide-telluride oxides (ranks 2–5) share the oxide/lanthanide/mean_z_mid profile but add a third element and a chalcogen, moving away from the pure binary structure that YbO demonstrated. Accepting the proposal maximizes expected AUC improvement this round while keeping the door open to boundary probes in later rounds if Ce1O1 confirms the cell.

claim_boundary: This development audit verifies one response-level semantic failure mode on one material route. It does not establish general scientific reasoning accuracy or confirm the transfer effect.
